Post 1

📉 New 50-day low. ASX 200 dropped 77.40pts or 0.88% to 8,672.50 Tuesday, shedding 2.78% over five days. Materials led the selloff while healthcare bucked the trend. The index is flat year-to-date — but the tape is deteriorating. #ASX #ausbiz

Post 2

🔻 Materials -2.21%, Energy -1.62%, Financials -1.08% dragged the index lower. Healthcare +1.50% and Consumer Staples +0.88% were the only meaningful offsets. Risk-off rotation in plain sight. #ASX #mining #energy #ausbiz

Post 3

📈 TLX surged 8.63% to AUD 17.75 — Telix Pharmaceuticals the standout in a sea of red, anchoring healthcare's +1.50% session. Meanwhile KCN shed 6.57% to AUD 5.12, the session's hardest fall. #ASX #healthcare #ausbiz

Post 4

🪙 Gold at AUD 6,079.27/oz with AUD/USD at 0.7125. Silver AUD 89.22/oz. Platinum AUD 2,481.14/oz. Elevated gold in AUD terms offers little comfort — miners still sold off hard as Materials dropped 2.21%. #gold #silver #mining #ASX

Post 5

Watch Materials. Down 2.21% Tuesday, 2.78% over five days, ASX at a 50-day low. Does gold at AUD 6,079/oz stabilise the sector or does selling pressure deepen? Where do you see support — hold 8,600 or retest lower? #ASX #ausbiz #gold
